discussion_comments.comment_body: If this cache use is removed, Kong will have to repeat the upstreams update on every worker, which would be wasteful. I believe there's no need to remove this. Also, as `"balancer:targets:" .. upstream.id` and `"balancer:upstreams:" .. upstream_id` are still used, it increases the risk of inconsistency.
